title: Pricing Basis for Rental Days, Protection and Equipment on the Car Rental Rate Classes
content:
On the Car Rental Rate Classes the rental rate is charged day by day at the rate class's own daily rate, with the weekly rate substituted whenever 7 or more consecutive days are booked and the weekend rate applied to Saturdays and Sundays within a rental of fewer than 7 days. An optional item is sold only while the rental record stands at confirmed or picked up. A vehicle kept beyond the booked return is charged the class's extra-hour fee for each hour past its grace period, and once the hours charged reach the class's extra-day rate the extra day is charged instead of further hours. The collision damage waiver, theft protection, personal accident cover and roadside assistance are included or charged per rental day exactly as the class prescribes, and a product included in the class is never also charged. Satellite navigation, child seats, snow chains and ski racks are charged at the class's own amounts, the first two per day and the last two for the whole rental. Sales tax is applied to the rental total after every charge above has been added, and never to the deposit hold.

**A clause no longer in force.** The following sentence of this basis has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force: "Additional drivers beyond the class's free count are charged per driver per rental day, and a driver never named on the agreement is not insured at all." It is recorded here so that it is not applied.

**Which rate governs a day.**

| The rental books | The rate charged |
|---|---|
| 7 or more consecutive days | The class's weekly rate, substituted for the daily rate |
| Fewer than 7 days, a Saturday or Sunday | The class's weekend rate |
| Fewer than 7 days, any other day | The class's own daily rate |

**Keeping the vehicle past the booked return.** Time past the booked return is free until the class's grace period has run. After that, each hour is charged at the class's extra-hour fee. The hours accumulate only so far: once the hours charged reach the class's extra-day rate, the extra day is charged in place of any further hours.

**Where an item may be sold at all.** An optional item is sold only while the rental record stands at confirmed or picked up, and the rental record itself is the authority for that, read before the item is sold. A rental standing at booked, cancelled, recorded as a no-show, returned or closed is not open for an optional item.

**Protection and equipment.** Whether the waiver, theft protection, personal accident cover and roadside assistance are carried in the rate or charged for each rental day is settled by the class, and a product the class carries is never charged for on top. Satellite navigation and child seats are charged at the class's amount for each rental day; snow chains and ski racks at the class's amount for the whole rental.

**Tax.** Sales tax is applied to the rental total once every charge above has been added to it, and is never applied to the deposit hold.

superseded_clauses: Additional drivers beyond the class's free count are charged per driver per rental day, and a driver never named on the agreement is not insured at all.
